== Fox Tail == 
[[File:Fox Tail.jpg|thumb|420px|right|Fox Tail‎]]

* Acquired by: Slaying [[Fox]]es in [[The Storm Horns]]
* Usable in the following:
** Poaching for the Poacher: Three tails for a chest
** The Whispering Timber: A single tail guarantees a success in the ritual.

* Description: This wiry trophy a useful commodity in the [[Storm Horns]].

Note: Slaying a Fox in the Storm Horns can result in a Fox Tail in your inventory. {{Bind|no|drops=leaving}}
